The PKGBUILD contains only standard variable assignments and function definitions for build/package phases. The .SRCINFO, .nvchecker.toml, and .gitignore files are all declarative metadata with no executable content. The qwen model correctly identified this as SAFE with sound reasoning. data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by tool/parser failures, not security concerns. The deepseek-v4-flash model's response had a malformed closing tag (</file> instead of </security_assessment>), causing the parser to fail despite the model providing a valid SAFE assessment. The openrouter/free model output 'User Safety: safe' without proper XML structure, also causing a parser failure. learnings: Parser robustness: Implement fallback parsing for models that don't strictly follow XML output format (e.g., handle 'User Safety: safe' or malformed closing tags)
